_source: 2026-10-31 (V-094). The reasons a contradiction may be named for. Each is a description of what the two texts say, never of the authors. The label is shown to the instructor with both quotes.

reasons.objective_reported_not_done: the result says what the objective set out to do was not done or not achieved
reasons.opposite_result: the result reports the opposite of what the objective aimed for
reasons.stated_target_missed: the objective names a target, and the result reports a value that misses it
